title: Rock Band Kroi Performs STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Anime's Opening Song
content: Warner Bros. Japan announced on Wednesday that rock band Kroi is performing the opening theme song "Spin" for the STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure anime, and began streaming the anime's clean opening sequence: Warner Bros.
author: ANN

title: 6th Live-Action Midnight Diner Series Reveals Returning Cast, Staff, October 20 Debut
content: The staff for the sixth live-action series adaptation of Yarō Abe 's Shinya Shokudō (The Midnight Diner or La Cantine de Minuit ) manga announced on Wednesday the new series' returning cast members, returning and new directors, writers, and October 20 premiere on MBS , TBS and other channels in Japan.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Fourteenth Ending Featuring "gr8 story" by SuG
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its foureenth ending, featuring the song “gr8 story” by SuG. The song was used in Episodes 166-177, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Rock Band cinema staff Announces Disbandment After 21 Years
content: The official website of cinema staff announced on Wednesday that the four-member rock band will disband on September 12, 2027, following their final one-man live concert at Toyasu PIT in Tokyo.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System Episode 13 Preview Revealed
content: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System has revealed the preview for Episode 13 ahead of its September 24 premiere. The series is streaming on Crunchyroll and previously confirmed two consecutive cours . Studio GoHands is in charge of the animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Anime's New Video Teases Escape from Akasaka
content: Netflix streamed a new "sneak peek" video, teasing an escape scene from an Arasaka building, from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime on Tuesday. The staff describe the series: It presents a new standalone 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077— a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge.
